name: island-echoes
description: 3D globe of seven remote islands. Endangered and extinct creatures answer as field agents, only from cited NASA POWER, GBIF and island fact-file sources.

paragraphs: A 3D globe of seven remote islands. On each one, an endangered or extinct creature reports in as a sensor-equipped field agent and answers questions in the first person, using only facts it can cite.
features: Globe: globe.gl with NASA GIBS imagery (true colour, relief, night lights, sea surface temperature). Click a pin or pick an island from the list to fly there.

Creatures: four procedural canvas animations (bird, marine, reptile, mammal) and one spoken field report per creature (browser speech synthesis). A pause control stops all motion; reduced-motion preferences start paused.
Sensors: the readouts beside each creature are NASA POWER 20-year climatology (temperature, rainfall, wind, humidity) for that island's grid cell, with a monthly trace.

Library: search each island's sourced facts or filter by category (species, water and ocean, climate, ecology, threats, history and more). Climate and species searches also pull live NASA POWER and GBIF entries. No API…

Chat (optional): shown when the server has an answer model configured (LLMPROVIDER: a free local model, a free hosted one, a no-model baseline, or Anthropic). Answers show numbered citations and the evidence cards…

whatItDoes.text: A 3D globe of seven remote islands. On each one, an endangered or extinct creature reports in as a sensor-equipped field agent and answers questions in the first person, using only facts it can cite.

requirements.text: Setting LLMPROVIDER=extractive in the Render dashboard switches on the no-model chat; a paid provider key is optional.
